OUR_V2_FAST.development_status: Configuration selected on development tracks; independent holdout evaluated separately

DeepRhythm.training_overlap: Training corpus not fully documented; exploratory GTZAN evaluation
DeepRhythm.preprocessing: Official librosa 22050 Hz; complete nonoverlapping 8 s chunks; trailing remainder discarded

TempoCNN.runtime: TensorFlow v1 Session; original tempocnn librosa frontend (Essentia unavailable on Windows)
TempoCNN.preprocessing: 11025 Hz, 1024 STFT, hop 512, 40 mel bands 20-5000 Hz, 256-frame patches hop 128; original std_normalizer
TempoCNN.aggregation: Original author: argmax of mean patch probabilities + 30 BPM; no interpolation
TempoCNN.minimum_context: 256 frames (~11.9 s); original frontend zero-pads 8 s inputs
TempoCNN.training_overlap: Extended Ballroom, LMDTempo, MTGTempo per official metadata; full GTZAN overlap not independently verified

BeatThis.license: MIT (code and published weights, per official repository)
BeatThis.output_type: beats; BPM derived as 60 / median positive finite inter-beat interval
BeatThis.training_overlap: small0 excludes GTZAN per official model table
BeatThis.preprocessing: Official soundfile/torchaudio loader, soxr to 22050 Hz, log-mel spectrogram
